snippet.title: Team Fight Showcase | Arisen Force: HeroTest
snippet.description:
Demo&Wishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2951840/Arisen_Force_HeroTest/

Overview:
Arisen Force: HeroTest is an A-RPG game featuring exquisite high-definition pixels ,it combines the engaging Stylish Actional combat experience.
Join the exquisite-definition pixel style world "HeroTest", and experience an exhilarating, stylized combat journey with heroes from temporal rift to fight against the dark erosion of the void.

Platform: Steam Q4 2024 | PS NS XBOX 2025
Developer: Lemport
Publisher: Lemport
Category: ARPG
Contact: arisenforceteam@outlook.com

PressKit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1k6K0MM_e6oWhlN_UmAm37aLl3D_t6Br9?usp=sharing

Official SNS: 
https://www.youtube.com/@UCyZ9yZDyE5LzM673NZMvz8A 
https://twitter.com/Contrariagame

Coporate Composer: 
https://www.youtube.com/@UC70EMUkdQRmxD4MlHlOudTA 
C. Filipe Alves (theflep) He composed the music for many levels inside the Tower of Time and also created our theme song.
